questions.subject: History
questions.body: Sher Shah Suri — credited with laying the foundation of the Grand Trunk Road and introducing the silver 'Rupiya' — built his mausoleum in which present-day Bihar town?
questions.explanation: Sher Shah Suri's mausoleum stands at Sasaram (present-day Rohtas district, Bihar), built on a platform in the middle of an artificial lake. Constructed during his own lifetime, it is regarded as one of the finest examples of Indo-Afghan (Sur-era) architecture and is said to have influenced the later Mughal garden-tomb tradition.
